item.title: 🔴 CISA Adds 5 Actively Exploited Artifactory, ScreenConnect, and RouterOS Flaws to KEV
item.description:
Why this matters: Potentially urgent issue — confirm whether your environment is exposed.
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added five security flaws impacting JFrog Artifactory, ConnectWise ScreenConnect, and MikroTik RouterOS to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation in the wild. Details of the vulnerabilities are as follows - CVE-2026-42016 (CVSS score: 8.1) - An incorrect authorization

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 21h

item.title: 🔴 Florida confirms DMV database breached via stolen police account
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and watch for suspicious sign-ins.
The Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles (FLHSMV) has confirmed that its DAVID driver database suffered a data breach, saying the attackers gained access using credentials belonging to a police department employee. [...]
